translations.account.title: Your account
translations.account.exportIntro: Download every profile, relationship and the email of each profile's maintainer as one JSON file, to import later. Private profiles are included with their names, so keep the file safe. Each download is recorded in the audit history.
translations.import.title: Data import
translations.import.intro: Load a data export file into this instance. It only works while the instance has no profiles. Every profile, relationship and marriage keeps its consent as in the file. A profile goes to the account with its maintainer's verified email; if there is none here, you become its maintainer. The file is imported whole or not at all, and the import is recorded in the audit history.
translations.import.result: Imported {$INTERPOLATION} profiles, {$INTERPOLATION_1} parent–child links and {$INTERPOLATION_2} marriages. {$INTERPOLATION_3} maintainer accounts were found here.

translations.import.invalidFile: The file cannot be imported. Nothing was saved.
translations.import.tooLarge: This file is too large to import.

translations.signIn.aboutAccount: Your account keeps only your Google email address. It does not add you to the family graph; you can claim or create profiles later.
translations.transfer.title: Transfer to another account
translations.transfer.intro: As an administrator you can make another account this profile's maintainer at once, without its approval. Its relationships and approvals stay as they are.
translations.users.intro: Every account on this instance. You can move profiles to another account without its approval. Their relationships and approvals stay as they are, and each move is recorded.
